Ensure effective processes for communicating relevant information, including company, site, department, and team performance, to all team members are in place.
Continuously mentor and coach operators on acceptable mining standards and effective techniques on machinery to achieve these standards.
Identify skills gaps and training requirements and assist in developing training packages as required to close the skills gap.
Coordinate and assist with the delivery of training to employees.
Actively review the work performance of technicians and provide feedback to the area supervisors including the talent and succession planning for designated key roles.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Ensure general housekeeping within the mine is of a high standard.
Perform all roles and responsibilities that support and reflect the company’s mission and core values.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have
Relevant trade qualification in Heavy Equipment Fitting, Auto Electrical and Automation
5+ years plus of underground mining experience (Essential)
2+ years Shift Supervisor experience (Essential)
Organizational skills – Good time management skills.
Good communication and interpersonal skills – Be an effective communicator and listener.
Extensive knowledge of SHE Management System relevant to K92 i.e. Policy and Procedures.
Supervisory skills – Be a good leader, motivator and teacher.
Good command of the English Language (oral & written).
Knowledge of various heavy earthmoving machinery components.
Knowledge and understanding of the Duty of Care standards, occupational Health & Safety Act & Regulations, Mining Inspection Act & Regulations.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.

In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

27194.description:
Metallurgist - Recovery Plant Metallurgy
About Us
New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.
The New Porgera Limited now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual to join our Processing Technical Services Department as
Metallurgist - Recovery Plant Metallurgy.
About the role
The
Metallurgist - Recovery Plant Metallurgy
is responsible for providing metallurgical support and technical expertise to ancillary process areas within the processing plant. The role focuses on monitoring plant performance, optimising metallurgical processes, supporting operational efficiency, and ensuring production targets, recovery, safety, and quality standards are achieved.
A candidate with strong experience of over 3 years in Leach/Refinery and Cyanide Detoxification processes is preferred.

About New Porgera
New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a company incorporated in Papua New Guinea and owns the Porgera Gold Mine in Enga Province. The Porgera Gold Mine will employ nearly 3,000 Papua New Guineans at full production, and over the last 30 years of life of the mine it has contributed approximately 10% of Papua New Guinea’s total annual exports
NPL is currently seeking a qualified and experienced individual to join the Emergency Response Team as an
Officer - Emergency Response.
About the role
Are you an Emergency Response Professional with theoretical training but not much practical experience? Do you want more ‘hands on’ experience in both Surface and Underground Mining Operations? Do you want to test your skills? Do you want to learn more? If so, the newly opened Porgera Mine is for you! We have a fresh new team established, new fire trucks and equipment on order and Australian Recognized Training available for the right candidate! Nursing Officer – Port Moresby Based
Corporate Services - Port Moresby, NCD
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 34 years. Today we are in one of the largest business schools in the country and offer degree programs in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies, and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 11 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.
Our success is the fruit of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and future citizens on Papua New Guinea.
A CAREER WITH US:
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learned skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and we believe that each employee should be in the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.
ABOUT THIS ROLE:
The Nursing officer will provide professional nursing care to students, staff, and visitors at the university Health Centre, ensuring the well-being and safety of all individuals within the university community. The Officer ensure proper medical response during emergencies, promotes preventive healthcare programs, maintain health records confidentially, and support university health and safety initiatives.
The Nursing Officer is required to stay within or be readily accessible to the campus to provide timely medical assistance and emergency support whenever needed.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Provide clinical nursing care to students, staff and faculty, including assessment, treatment, education and referral.
Maintain accurate and confidential medical records for all patients.
Organize and participate in health education sessions, workshops, and campaigns to promote health awareness among the university community.
Act as a first responder in emergencies within the university, providing immediate care and coordinating with other medical professionals as necessary.
Monitor and record patients’ conditions and provide appropriate healthcare guidance.
Assist in medical procedures and examinations.
Refer patients to specialists or other medical facilities when necessary.
Participate in health promotion, education, and prevention programs such as first aid for the university community.
Advise on best practices in areas such as nutrition, exercise, stress management and general health.
Act as an advocate for the patient, ensuring that their medical, emotional, and holistic needs are met.
Ensure compliance with PNG Health regulations and university policies.
Support students with chronic health conditions or disabilities.
Work collaboratively with student affairs and services, security, HR and academic departments etc.
Qualification & Experiences
Diploma or degree in nursing from a recognized institution
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in an educational or community health setting
Current and valid nursing license
Proficient word-processing, spreadsheet, and database program skills
Effective communication skills
Well-organized and flexible to respond to shifting priorities.
Apply

More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
As part of the technical services team and reporting to the Technical Services Manager, the primary purpose of this position is to provide short term mine engineering support to our operation as we encounter a period of significant growth. In this role, you will manage day-to-day mine activities underground, mentor nationals and grow your career as our output more than doubles in the next three years.
Key Accountabilities
Coordinate and drive mine scheduling & production activities as required (Daily / Weekly / Monthly) mine plans and reports to enable the business to meet its objectives in terms of production and cost.
Effective communication of all engineering plans and schedules to the underground workforce.
Mentor junior national engineers in drill & blast, ventilation, dewatering, backfilling and production processes.
Regular review of established processes and standards to maximise economic profit for the operation
Coordinate the scheduling of the UG mobile equipment fleet: Jumbos, loaders, trucks, longhole drill, diamond drill, raisebore.
Ensure QAQC of explosives charging practices. Establishes schedules for drill and blast barging for the underground mining at K92 Mining.
Monitor the performance of any contractors involved in these activities.
Reviews with other engineering specialist, mining production targets and ore specifications and liaises with process personnel accordingly.
About You
Qualifications & Experience
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have a tertiary qualification in Mining Engineering with a strong production focus
6 years plus of underground hard rock mining experience
Experienced with Deswik 3D modelling software – essential
Ability to analyze numerical and geographical data.
Well-developed planning and organizational skills.
Ability to work with minimum supervision.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
